title: Final, final, final call for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Side Events
summary: The absolute last chance to apply to host an official Side Event during TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is tonight, September 11, at 11:59 p.m. PT.
reason: Item is a TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 event logistics notice about the deadline to apply to host side events. It reports no model release, research, industry deal/market data, policy action, or open-source/tool release, so no active rule covers it.
